listing.name: LittleBigPlanet 3 — lbp3-pc (btsouth)
listing.summary: Early preview 0.1 reaches Pod, Prologue, completed Introduction/Legend of Bunkum, and walkable Needlepoint Peaks. Later levels, Create and saving untested; audio not checked in detail. Online servers unavailable, some imports stubbed; first cache fill can run 15–20 FPS. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Own decrypted base CUSA00063 01.00 directory with eboot.bin, sce_module and sce_sys; no update merged. Extract owned PKG with recent tooling.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: README recommends LittleBigPlanet3-port-x86_64.AppImage and sha256 sidecar. Launcher chooses the owned folder, prepares image/shaders and starts Play. Source alternative build.sh plus GTK4 launcher. Data in ~/.local/share/lbp3-port; one copy due to /tmp/.lbpS link.
